remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600 -D__WINESRC__)

spec2def(xinput1_3.dll xinput1_3.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# xinput1_3.dll is all Rust (xinput1_3-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/xinput1_3-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# Wine 11.19's HID implementation (dlls/xinput1_3/main.c); xinput1_4 builds the same
# source with its own spec, as Wine does.
# main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/xinput1_3-rust/src/xinput1_3/main.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(xinput1_3_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.c)
target_link_libraries(xinput1_3_shims PRIVATE wine libhid libsetupapi libadvapi32 libuser32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libkernel32_vista libntdll)
set_wine_module(xinput1_3_shims)
add_cargo_module(xinput1_3 xinput1_3-cargo xinput1_3.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE xinput1_3-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS xinput1_3_shims psdk)

include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle
